thread:
Maria (PM): quick sync: enterprise prospect wants GA-ready SLA for Dedicated: 99.9% successful token emission over 30d. want to decide product stance + launch artifacts.
Lena (ProdOps): high level: we need clear measurement definition, ownerable runbooks, and a pricing approach. Legal flagged "successful token emission" as vague.
Kavi (Infra): measurement suggestion: tokens_emitted / tokens_requested per-customer per-region aggregated to a 30d rolling window. tie to stored request logs so we can audit.
Oscar (SRE): operationally, the hard failure modes are cold-starts, node OOMs leading to partial token returns, and KV cache loss during model switches. each should be enumerated in the SLA with mitigations.
Nadia (FinOps): cost impact: to materially reduce cold starts we need a warm baseline. rough estimate: +8-14% GPU-hours depending on pool utilization. also potential monitoring egress costs for per-token telemetry.
Maria (PM): acceptable trade? propose tiered SLA: default 99.5% included, 99.9% as paid upgrade with warm-pool optionality. want language that clearly lists exclusions.
Kavi (Infra): agreed. proposed mitigations to include in the SLA appendix: 1) warm pool baseline (config sample), 2) pre-pull on deploys, 3) fallback chain (primary->quantized warmed->cached prefix->error with ETA).
Lena (ProdOps): doc needs: SLA spec, appendices (measurement, exclusions), runbook, customer-facing dashboard spec, compliance report export. owners?
Maria (PM): owners: Kavi -> infra + canary plan; Lena -> SLA doc + dashboard spec; Oscar -> runbook + oncall playbook; Nadia -> pricing uplift numbers. Drafts in 3 business days.
SupportBot: alerting suggestion: fire P1 if rolling 30d rate < 99.95% for >60m, notify owners and open ticket.
Oscar (SRE): also add an early-warning metric: 7d rolling rate < 99.97% should trigger a paged alert to ops so we can preempt customer impact.
Nadia (FinOps): pricing models to analyze: A) flat +12% uplift on committed pool; B) SLA-as-add-on (monthly line item); C) per-token surcharge during warm-hours. will model and attach numbers.
Kavi (Infra): quick config snippet for appendix: ```yaml
warm_pool:
  enabled: true
  min_instances: 12
  buffer_percent: 0.10
prepull_on_deploy: true
```
Lena (ProdOps): console feature: a per-customer "SLA compliance" panel, CSV export for auditors, and a downloadable 30d compliance certificate. reduces disputes.
Maria (PM): please include example SLA clause for legal. short enumerated exceptions and the fallback promise (explicitly notes reduced fidelity).
Oscar (SRE): we'll instrument token_success_ratio, fallback_count, kv_cache_evictions, and provide a composite sla_health gauge. will bake alerts and dashboards.
SupportBot: I can auto-generate the initial incident templates and customer templates for breaches. assign to Oscar for review.
Maria (PM): timeline recap: drafts due in 3 days; canary plan before leadership review; include cost and console spec. If FinOps flags high cost, we'll present tiered options. Thanks all.
